### Related Files
Behavioral data, related code, and stimuli used can be found at OSF: https://osf.io/hrfv7/.

### Exclusion list
Participants 1-5: pilot participants ID.

Participant 14: excluded for squeezing emergency ball while in the scanner.

Participant 30: excluded because the participant stopped the scan after round 7.

Participant 34: excluded because the participant stopped the scan after Round 2.

Participant 13 20 23 24 27: excluded because not meeting pre-determined behavioral threshold.

### fMRI data notes
sub-MONSTERA01 to sub-MONSTERA05 are pilot subjects with modifications in study design. Therefore they are removed from the online dataset.
